title.en: Nature and functions of a stock exchange
title.hi: Nature and functions of a stock exchange

definition.en: A stock exchange is a regulated marketplace where securities such as shares and bonds are bought and sold, facilitating capital formation and liquidity in the economy.
definition.hi: A stock exchange is a regulated marketplace where securities such as shares and bonds are bought and sold, facilitating capital formation and liquidity in the economy.

importanceInUpsc.en: Understanding stock exchanges is vital for UPSC GS-3 as they serve as the backbone of the financial market, influencing investment flows and corporate governance. Questions often focus on their role in capital mobilization, regulatory oversight by SEBI, and their impact on the broader Indian economy.
